text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! The Arima Kinen has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A stage where only the best and most popular of Umamusume can compete—perfect for me, I must say!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's right! My elegant victory will end yet another year on a strong note.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Because I'm a first-rate Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Supporting Fan
text_block_list.text: King! You got this today!

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Fan
text_block_list.text: Don't lose to anyone! Do your best, King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: (Hehe… I have to admit I'm loving all this attention.)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: (With a win at the Arima Kinen bringing the year to a perfect close, I'll be showered in even more glorious attention.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, it looks like King has finally graced us with her presence.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I haven't seen you since the holiday. Glad to know you're doing well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. I'm so glad all of my fine opponents from throughout the year have gathered here to race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: This fierce battle, this grand contest, this miraculous meeting—it's our destiny!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is this? Almost everyone is here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, not "almost."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Did ya forget about me, King? I hope not, 'cause I don't plan on losing today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm the rival of both of you. I have to win!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Well, you can certainly talk the talk, but can you walk the walk?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: For goodness' sake, I was supposed to be the sole star of this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh well. Come on, then.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You'll all serve well as my backup dancers for today's show!
